label: Profile header
purpose: Introduce a person or account at the top of a profile — avatar, name/handle, a short bio, key stats, and the single primary relationship action.
when_to_use: The header of a user/account/organisation profile page.
when_not_to_use: A compact author byline inside a feed item — use the feed-item header (an Item) instead.
composition: Identity — a large Avatar, the display name, and a muted @handle
Bio — one or two lines of description
Stats — a small row (posts / followers / following) as label + number, separated by a Separator
Action — exactly one filled Button (Follow / Edit profile); any secondary action is outline or ghost
primary_action: Exactly one filled Button — the relationship action (Follow, or Edit profile on your own profile). Message / more are outline or ghost.
responsive: Avatar + identity stack on mobile and sit inline at sm+; the stats row wraps rather than scrolls.
accessibility: the display name is the section heading (aria-labelledby)
stats are label + number, never a number alone
the primary action has a real accessible name, not just an icon
content: Ships realistic 2one placeholder identity (name, handle, bio, stats) — adapt the CONTENT, keep the STRUCTURE.
anti_patterns: two competing filled Buttons (Follow AND Message both primary)
a per-user coloured avatar ring for warmth (a second decorative hue — see the expressive-warmth decision)
stats as bare numbers with no label
assumptions: Name, handle, bio and stats are PLACEHOLDER 2one content — replace with real data.
The single primary action is Follow (or Edit profile on the viewer's own profile).
Avatar uses the AvatarFallback monogram when no photo exists (docs/placeholders.md).

references.note: shadcn ships no profile block (canonical blocks are dashboard, sidebar, login, signup — https://ui.shadcn.com/blocks). Composed from shadcn PRIMITIVES (Card, Avatar, Button, Badge, Separator); every part a real, in-repo component.
